claims.claim_text: The memory Mk is an additive memory consisting of a single channel image, incremented by 1 at the location pk predicted by the AgentRNN at iteration k.
claims.normalized_text: The memory Mk is an additive single-channel image incremented at predicted location pk each iteration.

claims.claim_text: The AgentRNN outputs a heatmap image over the next pose of the agent, and the arg-max operation is used to obtain the coarse pose prediction pk from this heatmap.
claims.normalized_text: AgentRNN outputs a heatmap for next pose; arg-max yields coarse pose prediction pk.

claims.claim_text: The AgentRNN employs a shallow convolutional meta-prediction network with a fully-connected layer that predicts a sub-pixel refinement of the pose δpk and also estimates the heading θk and the speed sk.
claims.normalized_text: AgentRNN uses a shallow convolutional meta-prediction network with fully-connected layer to predict sub-pixel pose refinement δpk, heading θk, and speed sk.

claims.claim_text: The AgentRNN is unrolled at training time for a fixed number of iterations, and the losses are summed together over the unrolled iterations due to the non-traditional RNN design employing an explicitly crafted memory model instead of a learned memory.
claims.normalized_text: AgentRNN is unrolled for fixed iterations during training; losses summed due to explicit crafted memory model replacing learned memory.

claims.claim_text: At each time, the updated state of the agent and the environment is obtained via a perception system that processes sensory output from the real-world or from a simulation environment.
claims.normalized_text: Agent and environment state updated via perception system processing sensory output from real or simulated environments.

claims.claim_text: The intended route is obtained from the router and is updated dynamically conditioned on whether the agent was able to execute past intents or not.
claims.normalized_text: Intended route from router is dynamically updated based on agent's execution of past intents.
